standard.summary: 预热步数，在此步数内 alpha/beta3
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The warmup step count, within which alpha/beta3
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 预热步数，在此步数内 alpha/beta3 从初始值线性增大到目标值。0 = 无预热。

advanced_en.principle: Warmup steps over which alpha/beta3 grow linearly from their initial values to the target values. 0 = no warmup.
